annotations.title: Make a new kit download link

description: Issue a fresh single-use download link for a kit you bought: after buy's link was used or ran out, or for a kit order your owner approved by email. It works once, for 10 minutes; the answer has the file's sha256 and reissues_left. Older links still work until used or expired.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.
